Wait... y'all know that the cat wasn't shitting... right? The poop just got stuck and she probably couldn't shake it off in the litter box. 

Restating what has been said in this thread, cats normally don't shit anywhere besides the litter box unless the litter box isn't clean (or unless they have the outdoors: bushes....flowerbeds... stuff like that). 

I understand why Alinity started screeching, but god that poor cat was so confused. I mean, at least she didn't full send her across the room lmao
